target.title: fix(oauth): pass workspace context to resolveProviderIdForAuth on refresh failure
target.body:
> [!NOTE]
> **AI-Assisted Contribution:** This PR was prepared and validated with the assistance of an AI coding assistant (Antigravity/Gemini).

## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a problem where aliased provider lookup fails to resolve workspace-scoped aliases on oauth token refresh failures (pr #100841).

**Symptom/Behavior:**
Line 471 calls `resolveProviderIdForAuth(cred.provider)` with only one argument, omitting the configuration and workspace directory parameters. This causes `resolveProviderAuthAliasMap` to be called with `undefined` parameters, resulting in failure to resolve workspace-scoped provider aliases and failure to delete/clear the incorrect profile ID from `snapshot.lastGood`.

Affected location: `[src/agents/auth-profiles/oauth.ts](file://src/agents/auth-profiles/oauth.ts#L471) (compiled as `dist/oauth-R_OaG_Ep.js` inside `catch (error)` block)`

## Why This Change Was Made

Implemented a surgical fix to resolve the logic discrepancy.

**Solution Overview:**
Pass the full parameters (context/config) to `resolveProviderIdForAuth`:
  ```javascript
  const providerKey = resolveProviderIdForAuth(cred.provider, {
      config: cfg,
      workspaceDir: params.workspaceDir
  });
  ```

## User Impact

Corrects behavior to ensure that: When clearing the last good profile on OAuth refresh failures, the aliased provider ID should be resolved using the full workspace configuration (`cfg` and `workspaceDir`) to ensure workspace-scoped aliases/plugins are correctly respected.

## Evidence

### Unit Tests / Verification Suite
- Completed workspaceDir threading to all OAuth profile resolution and refresh paths (including plugin-sdk, cli-runner, and agents resolution paths).
- Reproduction/regression unit tests in `src/agents/auth-profiles/repro_1_4.test.ts`, `src/plugin-sdk/provider-auth.test.ts`, and `src/agents/cli-runner/prepare.test.ts` pass successfully.
